```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM main."rulings" r
JOIN main."cards" c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged'
  AND c.setCode = 'ORI'
  AND r.date >= DATE '2015-06-01' 
  AND r.date < DATE '2015-07-01'
```
